channel.title: stay(human).sec
channel.description: Cybersecurity, AI, and privacy explained properly — one fact, one fix, every day.

item.title: Is someone already inside your phone?
item.description: The 5-minute check that tells you for sure — session lists, unknown devices, and what to do if you find something.

item.title: The password mistake nobody thinks is a big deal
item.description: Why reusing one password anywhere is worse than you think, and how a password manager actually fixes it.

item.title: What is smishing?
item.description: The exact texts scammers send, why they work, and how to tell a real message from a fake one in seconds.

item.title: Incognito mode doesn't make you anonymous
item.description: It hides your history from the next person on this computer. It was never designed to hide you from anyone else.

item.title: The AI phone call that sounds exactly like your kid
item.description: It only takes a few seconds of audio from a social media video to clone a voice convincingly enough to fool a parent.

item.title: Turn on 2FA — here's what it actually protects
item.description: A stolen password alone stops working the moment 2FA is on. It's the single biggest upgrade available to you, and it takes about five minutes.

item.title: Anatomy of a phishing email, line by line
item.description: Every part of a phishing email is doing a specific job. Once you know what to look for, most of them fall apart in seconds.

item.title: How to spot a deepfake in 2026
item.description: The obvious tells from a few years ago mostly don't work anymore. Here's what actually still catches a fake.

item.title: Chick-fil-A's loyalty accounts just got hit by credential stuffing
item.description: Chick-fil-A didn't get hacked directly — attackers just tried stolen passwords from other breaches until some of them worked.
